summary: Cellebrite DI Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to clarify dilution figures following inquiries about its 2026 AGM proxy statement. The filing discloses share counts as of August 1, 2026: 251,341,060 ordinary shares outstanding; 12,917,566 shares subject to outstanding SIP awards; 10,418,086 shares available for future grant (after a 3,500,000 share reduction approved July 29, 2026); and 2,218,509 shares available under the ESPP. Total reserved shares equal 25,554,161; fully diluted count is 276,895,221, implying potential dilution of ~9.2%. This is a routine clarifying disclosure, not a special situation.
